subject: Security review coordination — Redwood access & SOC artifacts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security review coordination — Redwood access & SOC artifacts

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to set up a 60-minute security review so your security and infra teams can meet our security/compliance lead and SE to go through architecture, data flows, and SOC artifacts.

Proposed agenda:
- 10 mins introductions & scope
- 20 mins architecture + data flow (SE)
- 20 mins SOC2 / controls overview (Security)
- 10 mins Q&A and next steps

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Feb 17, 10:00–11:00 AM
- Wed Feb 18, 2:00–3:00 PM

I've attached a short pre-read (Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf) and a SOC2 summary. Hannah from our security team will lead the controls discussion; Diego will walk through the runtime architecture and network considerations.

Please let me know which slot works or suggest alternatives. Also flag any special attendees (VPN/allowlist owners, procurement) so we can include them.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (7 pages)
- SOC2_Summary.pdf (2 pages)

From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@acme-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Levin <markus.levin@acme-fin.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security review coordination — Redwood access & SOC artifacts

Marissa,

Thanks — that sounds good. We have our security triage on Wed mornings, so I can free up a slot on Wed Feb 18. 2:00–3:00 PM PT (5:00–6:00 PM EST) is workable for me. Markus from procurement is looped in to capture procurement-level asks (contracts/PSA).

Two quick asks before we lock the meeting:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood requires customer egress firewall openings or if the connection is outbound only?
2) We run an internal pre-meeting questionnaire — I can share it, would you prefer us to send it or should we fill yours?

Also — could you include a calendar invite and a Zoom link once times are confirmed?

Thanks,
Claire Thompson
Security Engineering Lead, Acme Financial
claire.thompson@acme-fin.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review coordination — Redwood access & SOC artifacts

Hi Claire / Markus,

Thanks for the quick turnaround — Wed Feb 18, 2:00–3:00 PM PT works for our side. I'm sending a tentative calendar invite (calendar_invite.ics) and a Zoom link — final invite will go once you confirm.

Pre-work and notes:
- Answering your firewall question: Redwood's hosted API is outbound-only from customer networks; for Dedicated/Private deployments we provide formal allowlist guidance. Diego will cover network diagrams in the meeting.
- I've uploaded a condensed pre-read and the SOC2 summary here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-preread
- Hannah — can you please prepare the SOC2 controls slide (20 mins) and bring any clarifying language for data residency & logging?
- Claire / Markus — if you have a short questionnaire, feel free to send it; we also have a short security questionnaire attached (security_questionnaire.xlsx) you can use instead.

Next steps:
- Claire to confirm final attendee list (VPN owner, network infra).
- Markus to flag procurement items to be covered in the call.
- Redwood to send final calendar invite and Zoom link.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- security_questionnaire.xlsx (1 sheet)
- calendar_invite.ics (holds tentative slot)

From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@acme-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Levin <markus.levin@acme-fin.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security review coordination — Redwood access & SOC artifacts

Marissa,

Confirmed — Wed Feb 18, 2:00–3:00 PM PT is good for our team. Attendees: myself, Markus Levin (procurement), Ravi Patel (network/security operations), and Anita Gomez (data governance).

We will use your questionnaire — I'll fill the network section prior to the meeting and share any additional context. Please go ahead and send the calendar invite with the Zoom link and any dial-in numbers.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Claire
